description: **Fix.** Watch auto-retry now deduplicates by workflow name, preventing multiple retries when parallel runs from the same workflow fail. Watch exits 0 (not 1) when no CI runs are found, since the release already succeeded.

**Feature.** Documentation expanded: new utility commands guide, fixed pipeline per-type inaccuracies, added Flutter release config and deploy env var expansion docs, improved section intros for AI citation.
